verdict.rationale: Copilot is built into GitHub with no install required. It answers questions about a codebase, researches repositories and drafts implementation plans, reviews code with one-click suggested changes, and proposes security fixes via Autofix. Together these deliver AI-generated insights and suggestions on the user's own repository data inside the product, and an early user's hands-on report corroborates the code suggestions. Missing for 10: insights over non-code data such as issues, projects or activity analytics, and independent corroboration of the in-product review and research features beyond editor suggestions.
